title: HR Director (India)
description:
**Our Story**


At Alight, we believe a company’s success starts with its people. Alight embraces values that come directly from our people – purposeful, human, united and growth\-minded – reflecting our inclusive culture and promise that our clients expect. We are passionate about connecting purpose with impact. Alight empowers clients to build a healthier and more financially secure workforce by unifying the benefits ecosystem across health, wealth, wellbeing, navigation, and absence management.

**Our Benefits**


With a comprehensive total rewards package, Alight offers programs and plans that support your mind, body, wallet, and life. Benefits include health, starting Day One. Additionally, Alight colleagues enjoy wellbeing programs, retirement plans, and career growth opportunities – all within a thriving global organization.

**Great Place to Work**


Thanks to the work of every colleague, Alight has received multiple awards of recognition including “Great Place to Work” for the past 7 years and Fortune’s “Best Companies to Work For.” To learn more about our company culture and awards **Click Here.**


We invite you to join our team! Learn more at careers.alight.com.

**About the Role**


This is a distinctive opportunity for an HR leader to shape the people agenda for a high\-growth India organization, influence business strategy and build scalable people solutions that support Alight’s next phase of transformation.


The India HR Director will lead the HR Business Partner and Employee Relations functions across Alight’s India operations, supporting leaders and colleagues across Gurgaon, Noida, Chennai, Hyderabad and Kochi. The role is a member of the India HR Leadership Team and reports to the India HR Head.


This highly visible leadership role is responsible for shaping and executing India’s people strategy. The HR Director will serve as a trusted advisor to the India Leadership Team, helping leaders navigate growth, organizational change, workforce complexity and talent priorities while strengthening a high\-performance culture grounded in Alight’s values.


The ideal candidate brings strategic judgment, operational discipline and strong enterprise partnership. They create structure in ambiguity, build scalable governance, identify insights from complex situations and translate strategy into practical execution. Success in this role requires strong business acumen, high emotional intelligence, executive presence and the ability to influence across a global matrix.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Business Partnership**

* Serve as the primary HR partner to the India Leadership Team, ensuring people priorities are directly aligned with business strategy, growth objectives and operational needs.
* Advise leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, succession, talent reviews, leadership effectiveness and change execution.
* Use workforce data, trends and insights to surface risks, identify opportunities and inform leadership decisions.
* Embed Alight’s values, culture and leadership expectations across the India organization.
* Build manager capability across India by equipping people leaders to drive performance, engagement, accountability, communication and colleague support with consistency and confidence.
* Connect people priorities to business outcomes, including operational stability, productivity, ramp readiness, attrition management and leadership capacity.

**HRBP, Employee Relations and Organizational Effectiveness**

* Lead, coach and develop a high\-performing HRBP and Employee Relations team.
* Establish clear operating rhythms, governance mechanisms and accountability across the HRBP and ER functions.
* Build consistent employee relations practices that balance colleague experience, business needs and risk management.
* Ensure effective handling of investigations, employee concerns, disciplinary matters and workplace issues across all locations.
* Lead workforce integration, employee rebadging and organizational transition initiatives, ensuring a seamless colleague experience, continuity of delivery and effective cultural integration.
* Drive consistency in manager practices, people decisions and employee experience across teams and locations.
* Establish proactive risk\-sensing mechanisms to identify engagement concerns, manager capability gaps, attrition risks, cultural hotspots and employee relations patterns before they escalate.
* Lead employee listening, engagement action planning and leader follow\-through across sites, translating colleague feedback into clear, measurable improvements.
* Strengthen cultural integration across legacy and incoming colleague populations by reinforcing one Alight identity, consistent leadership practices and inclusive employee experiences.

**HR Operations, Governance and Global Partnership**

* Design and implement scalable HR processes, operating mechanisms and governance frameworks that support India’s continued growth and complexity.
* Develop meaningful people metrics, dashboards and insights that strengthen accountability and decision\-making.
* Partner with global HR and business leaders to align enterprise priorities with India business needs.
* Advise global stakeholders on India workforce dynamics, labor market trends, regulatory requirements and cultural considerations.
* Build strong partnerships across Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, Learning \& Development, Talent Management, HR Operations, Legal and Compliance.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws, company policies and regulatory requirements across all India locations.
* Translate global policies, programs and standards into practical India\-ready execution, ensuring managers understand expectations and apply policies consistently across teams and locations.
* Maintain visible leadership across India locations through regular leader connects, employee forums, site visits and local issue\-resolution mechanisms.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Brings structure, clarity and momentum through periods of growth, ambiguity and change.
* Builds scalable systems, governance and operating mechanisms that create consistency, predictability and accountability.
* Demonstrates strong business acumen, sound judgment and disciplined execution.
* Identifies patterns, synthesizes complex information and translates insights into practical actions.
* Influences effectively across a complex global matrix and earns credibility with senior leaders.
* Communicates with executive presence, clarity and impact.
* Builds trust through high emotional intelligence, collaboration and partnership.
* Develops strong HRBP and Employee Relations capability while elevating the effectiveness and credibility of the broader HR function.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.
* 15\+ years of progressive HR experience, including significant HR Business Partner and Employee Relations leadership responsibilities, with at least 5 years leading teams.
* Experience operating within a large, complex, matrixed multinational organization.
* Demonstrated success building scalable HR operating models, governance frameworks and people processes.
* Experience leading workforce transitions, employee rebadging, integrations, acquisitions or other large\-scale organizational transformation initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labor laws, employee relations practices and regulatory requirements.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive business outcomes through people strategies.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and organizational effectiveness capabilities.
* Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Willingness to work from the office five days per week and travel periodically across India locations.

**Application and Interview**


By applying for a position with Alight, you understand that, should you be made an offer, it will be contingent on your undergoing and successfully completing a background check consistent with Alight’s employment policies. Background checks may include some or all the following based on the nature of the position: Government ID validation, education verification, employment verification, and criminal check, search against global sanctions and government watch lists, credit check, and/or drug test. You will be notified during the hiring process which checks are required by the position.


Alight requires all virtual interviews to be conducted on video. Please be aware that Alight is a camera\-on culture and may require occasional travel to one of our physical office locations.

**Our commitment to Inclusion**


We celebrate differences and believe in fostering an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. We know that diverse teams are stronger, more innovative, and more successful.


At Alight, we welcome and embrace all individuals, regardless of their background, and are dedicated to creating a culture that enables every employee to thrive. Join us in building a brighter, more inclusive future.


As part of this commitment, Alight will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation for the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact alightcareers@alight.com.


**Equal Opportunity Policy Statement**


Alight is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against anyone based on sex, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital or domestic partner status, citizenship, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics or conduct covered by federal, state, or local law. In addition, we take affirmative action to employ disabled persons, disabled veterans, and other covered veterans.


Alight provides reasonable accommodation to the known limitations of otherwise qualified employees and applicants for employment with disabilities and sincerely held religious beliefs, practices and observances, unless doing so would result in undue hardship. Applicants for employment may request reasonable accommodations/modifications by contacting their recruiter.

**Authorization to work in the Employing Country**


Applicants for employment in the country in which they are applying (Employing Country) must have work authorization that does not, now or in the future, require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the Employing Country and with Alight.


Note, this job description does not restrict management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job to other entities; including but not limited to subsidiaries, partners, or purchasers of Alight business units.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
Overview:

SSOE is seeking a full life cycle recruiting and Talent Acquisition Manager role based in Mumbai, India. The position partners with hiring managers, HR leaders, and business leaders to identify, attract, assess, and hire top talent for India\-based openings.  

This role is for a hands\-on leader who will support full life cycle recruitment for assigned requisitions and also serve as a trusted advisor on India talent market trends, workforce planning, compensation expectations, notice\-period norms, candidate engagement, recruitment compliance, and inclusive hiring practices. This position also manages, coaches, and develops a team of recruiters while ensuring recruitment work is delivered with quality, consistency, and efficiency.
AI and Innovation:

At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe\-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows.
Responsibilities:
**Team Leadership and Section Management*** Lead, coach, direct, coordinate, and supervise Talent Acquisition section personnel.
* Manage, coach, and develop recruiters by setting goals, providing feedback, supporting professional growth, and driving accountability.
* Monitor recruitment workload, recruiter assignments, hiring priorities, talent pipelines, and recruiting capacity.
* Identify team strengths, development areas, and training needs; implement training plans with HR, Training and Development, or other appropriate resources.
* Support employee relations activities for section personnel with assistance from Human Resources.
* Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, inclusion, compliance, continuous improvement, and high performance.

**Full Life Cycle Recruiting and Candidate Management*** Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for mid\- to senior\-level India\-based roles, including intake, sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management, negotiation, pre\-joining engagement, and onboarding handoff.
* Champion the candidate experience through timely communication, clear expectations, structured feedback, offer transparency, and pre\-joining engagement.
* Communicate compensation, benefits, work model, career development opportunities, company culture, and employee value proposition to candidates accurately.
* Support India\-specific recruitment practices, including notice\-period management, offer acceptance risk, counteroffer risk, joining documentation, and background verification coordination.

**Strategic Talent Advisory and Stakeholder Partnership*** Serve as a strategic talent advisor to hiring managers, HR Managers, and business leaders on workforce planning, talent availability, market intelligence, compensation trends, notice periods, and recruitment best practices.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs, role requirements, project staffing demands, critical skills, and hiring priorities.
* Educate hiring managers on recruitment processes, interview discipline, candidate evaluation, inclusive hiring, hiring compliance, salary discussions, notice periods, and offer\-closing strategies.
* Collaborate with HR, Total Rewards, Finance, Operations, Marketing, and business leadership on requisitions, postings, offers, compensation alignment, employer branding, documentation, and recruitment best practices.

**Sourcing Strategy and Talent Pipeline Development*** Develop and execute sourcing strategies using employee referrals, LinkedIn, job portals, professional networks, social media, diversity channels, campus partnerships, and recruitment vendors.
* Build relationships with colleges, universities, technical institutes, professional associations, industry networks, vocational schools, and community organizations.
* Represent the company at job fairs, campus events, professional networking events, industry forums, and talent branding initiatives in India.
* Manage external search firms, staffing partners, job boards, campus partners, and recruitment vendors; evaluate vendor quality, timelines, and cost\-effectiveness.

**India Recruitment Standards and Compliance*** Ensure recruiting processes align with fair, consistent, merit\-based, and inclusive hiring practices.
* Apply structured interviews and consistent candidate evaluation criteria.
* Maintain accurate requisition tracking, candidate documentation, interview feedback, offer records, and applicant tracking system data.
* Ensure proper handling of candidate personal data, recruitment records, background verification coordination, and pre\-employment documentation.
* Maintain awareness of India market practices related to notice periods, offer negotiation, counteroffers, candidate drop\-off risk, joining timelines, and pre\-joining engagement.
* Ensure compliance with company recruitment policies, approval workflows, compensation guidelines, documentation standards, data privacy expectations, and employment\-related hiring practices.
* Demonstrate sensitivity to regional, linguistic, cultural, and location\-specific talent dynamics across India.

**Recruitment Analytics, Process Improvement, and Special Projects*** Track recruitment metrics, including time\-to\-fill, pipeline health, source effectiveness, candidate experience, hiring manager satisfaction, diversity outreach, offer acceptance, joining ratio, vendor performance, and workload balance.
* Prepare recruitment reports, market insights, hiring updates, risks, and recommendations for HR, business, and senior leadership.
* Stay informed on India talent market trends, competitive hiring practices, compensation benchmarks, candidate expectations, and employment trends.
* Lead or support strategic recruitment programs, including diversity hiring, campus recruiting, employer branding, process improvement, recruiter capability building, talent mapping, and workforce planning.
* Lead special projects within Human Resources as assigned.
* Use AI or similar digital technology, where applicable and approved, to support recruitment, analytics, reporting, and process improvement.
* Travel may be required for business meetings, recruiting events, campus events, vendor meetings, or other company needs.


Qualifications:
##### **Education**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred in Human Resources, Business Management/Administration, Marketing, Communications, Psychology, or related field.

##### **Experience**

* 12\+ years of Talent Acquisition experience, preferably within India talent markets.
* Experience in corporate recruiting, RPO, contingency search, retained search, executive search, or similar environments.
* Proven experience managing, leading, coaching, or mentoring recruiters, recruitment teams, projects, or cross\-functional Talent Acquisition initiatives.
* Experience recruiting mid\- to senior\-level professional roles in India.
* Experience in the AEC industry strongly preferred.

##### **India Recruiting Knowledge**

* Strong knowledge of India hiring practices, talent markets, compensation trends, notice periods, candidate engagement, offer negotiation, joining risk management, and recruitment compliance.
* Working knowledge of recruitment documentation, background verification, and candidate data privacy expectations.

##### **Recruiting Tools and Systems**

* Expertise in applicant tracking systems, LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals, sourcing platforms, recruitment analytics, and external recruiting tools.

##### **Leadership and Communication Skills**

* Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, influencing, sales, negotiation, time management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to inspire, motivate, and develop others.

##### **Work Environment and Collaboration**

* Ability to work independently in a hybrid or distributed work model while collaborating across teams, locations, functions, and time zones.
* Experience working with global stakeholders or U.S.\-based hiring managers while recruiting India\-based talent preferred.
* Positive attitude, strong work ethic, sound judgment, and customer\-service orientation.

##### **Events and Employer Branding**

* Experience representing a company at campus, professional, or industry recruitment events in India.
* Experience with employer branding, campus hiring, diversity hiring, or talent community development in India preferred.

##### **Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting global or multinational organizations.
* Experience building or scaling recruitment teams, shared services, centers of excellence, or high\-volume hiring functions in India.
* Experience with recruitment dashboards, market mapping, talent intelligence, or workforce planning.
* Familiarity with recruiting for engineering, design, technical, project management, corporate services, or professional services roles.

description:
**Manager \- BizOps**

### **Location**: Hyderabad, India
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time; Salaried

Job Description
===============

**About Innovapptive**


Innovapptive is an enterprise SaaS company building an **AI\-powered Connected Worker Platform** for industrial organizations. Our platform connects frontline workers, back\-office systems, and assets in real\-time to drive safety, reliability, and operational productivity.


Leading global enterprises including Shell, Hess, Westlake Chemical, Kimberly\-Clark, Scott Miracle\-Gro, and Newmont Mining, rely on Innovapptive to transform how work gets done across plants and field operations.


Our customers have achieved **$50M\+ EBITDA** savings at a single enterprise, **10× improvement in frontline productivity**, and 15–20% reductions in maintenance costs.


Innovapptive is recognized as a Leader in **Frost \& Sullivan's** “Frost Radar 2025 \- Augmented Connected Worker Platforms”, with acknowledgments from Gartner and LNS Research, and is backed by **Vista Equity Partners** and **Tiger Global Management**.


With headquarters in Houston and an engineering center in Hyderabad, we have 300\+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ and are on a strong trajectory toward $100M ARR.

### **The Opportunity**


We are hiring a Manager BizOps to own Professional Services operations, capacity planning, project governance \& reporting, and audit \& compliance for our services organization. This role will also manage invoicing, revenue recognition, and billing utilization while delivering executive\-grade dashboards and insights to support P\&L and workforce decisions.

### **How You Will Make An Impact.**

* Professional Services operations: Establish and run standardized PMO operating models, project P\&L governance, RAID frameworks, billing milestones, and cross\-BU delivery processes to ensure predictable delivery and margin control.
* Capacity planning \& resource management: Build and maintain forecasting, utilization, bench\-time and resource\-availability models; produce demand vs. supply scenarios and hiring/bench recommendations.
* Project governance \& reporting: Lead portfolio governance (QBRs/MBRs/WBRs), milestone tracking, executive reporting, and enable real\-time decision intelligence through Power BI/Looker\-type dashboards.
* Audit \& compliance: Implement and maintain PMO audit frameworks, quality audits, CSAT governance and support controls required for ISO/SOC/CMMI style initiatives.
* Financial billing \& revenue tasks: Own invoicing cadence, billing utilization calculations, revenue recognition inputs, billing disputes, milestone billing workflows, and reconciliation with finance systems (e.g., NetSuite OpenAir or equivalent).
* Data management \& insights: Transform, cleanse, and maintain Professional Services datasets; build repeatable ETL/analysis processes and deliver actionable insights (utilization trends, margin levers, billing leakages) to leadership.
* Stakeholder \& leadership engagement: Present data\-backed recommendations to Executive Leadership, respond to ad\-hoc leadership queries, and partner closely with Finance, HR/recruiting, Sales and Delivery

### **What You Bring to the Team**

* 7\+ years in Professional Services operations, PMO, or business operations roles with end\-to\-end ownership of delivery and financial controls.
* Demonstrated experience with forecasting, utilization and capacity planning, project P\&L governance, and billing/revenue processes.
* Hands\-on data management: advanced Excel, ETL/transformation experience, Power BI (or Looker/Tableau) dashboarding and working knowledge of PSA tools (NetSuite OpenAir, Jira, or equivalent).
* Strong stakeholder management and executive presentation skills; comfortable answering leadership questions using data.
* Familiarity with audit/compliance frameworks and quality controls supporting ISO, SOC2 or CMMI initiatives is preferred.
* Proactive problem\-solver who anticipates issues and drives corrective action before they escalate.
* Data\-driven communicator who can simplify complex analytics into clear recommendations and confidently present to executive audiences.
* Collaborative operator who partners across all departments to influence outcomes without direct authority.
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or relevant advanced degree preferred

**You Will Be Measured On**
---------------------------

* Restore/achieve target Professional Services gross margin and reduce billing/revenue leakage. (Define numeric targets per company goals).
* Deliver automated executive dashboards and reduce reporting cycle time by \~50%.
* Improve utilization accuracy and reduce bench\-time month\-over\-month.
* Implement audit and quality controls required for compliance milestones (ISO/SOC/CMMI).

**Why Innovapptive**
--------------------


Enterprise customers across energy, manufacturing, and utilities. A platform that connects the frontline workforce to Enterprise systems. A product at the inflection point between “early traction” and “enterprise\-grade.” You’re the engineering leader who drives that transition. VP\-level role with direct CTO and CEO visibility.

**What We Offer:**

* A positive, open, and highly\-innovative environment and team
* Entrepreneurial spirit with unlimited opportunity to grow
* Opportunity to work with leading global brands on exciting and impactful projects
* Competitive Base Pay
* Best of plan on Vacation \& Paid Time Off.
* Provision of Medical Insurance for family \- self, dependent, spouse, dependent children, parents/parent\-in\-laws
* Paid Maternity and Paternity leave
* Bi\-annual reviews to ensure transparency and promoting high performance culture
* OKR Driven Performance Development Environment
* Learning \& Development \- access to wide range of e\-Learning courses (technical, Product, Process, etc.,)
* A host of Interest Groups/Clubs for Book Reading, Toastmasters, Sports \- Cricket, Volleyball, Throw\-ball, Badminton, TT, Music


Innovapptive does not accept and will not review unsolicited resumes from search firms.

PURPOSE \& OVERALL RELEVANCE FOR THE ORGANIZATION



eCommerce Post\-Order Operations sits at the core of our online business operations. With thousands of orders fulfilled and returned across Emerging Markets, delivering a seamless, reliable, and efficient experience is critical to meeting growing consumer expectations and creating moments that matter.

The Senior Manager Post\-Order Operations will lead the Post\-Order Operations team across Emerging Markets, ensuring that operational execution across outbound and inbound journeys maintains the highest standards of reliability and efficiency. This role drives operational excellence across order fulfillment, delivery, tracking, exceptions, returns, and reverse logistics, while continuously identifying opportunities to elevate consumer experience and operational efficiency.

A key responsibility is identifying, evaluating, and enabling new fulfillment capabilities based on consumer needs, business requirements, and market innovations. You will collaborate closely with diverse internal and external stakeholders, uniting technical system knowledge, consumer insights, process thinking, and structured communication.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1\. LEAD POST\-ORDER OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE


* Own end\-to\-end Post\-Order Operations across Emerging Markets, encompassing order fulfillment, delivery, tracking, delivery exceptions, cancellations, returns, reverse logistics, and refund process governance.
* Ensure reliable and efficient execution of outbound and inbound workflows by establishing clear operational standards, SLAs, governance mechanisms, and performance routines.
* Continuously monitor operational performance, proactively identifying risks, issues, and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Drive enhancement across key operational metrics, including OTIF Delivery, delivery reliability, Rev\-to\-net, cancellations, delivery exceptions, returns, and refund turnaround times.
* Ensure effective operational readiness and execution during peak trading periods, major commercial campaigns, and high\-volume events.
* Identify root causes of operational challenges and implement sustainable corrective solutions in partnership with key stakeholders.
* Partner with the eCommerce Planning and SCM teams to align warehouse and carrier processing capacity during both business\-as\-usual (BAU) and peak periods.

2\. DRIVE NEW DELIVERY \& FULFILLMENT CAPABILITIES


* Identify and enable new delivery and fulfillment capabilities across Emerging Markets aligned with consumer expectations, business goals, market trends, and industry innovations (including business case definition, planning, execution, and sustainment).
* Act as the regional subject matter expert for system enhancements, carrier services, delivery capabilities, Partner Program services, and future fulfillment channels.
* Partner with Supply Chain and eCommerce Cluster teams to assess operational feasibility and establish sustainable operating models for new capabilities.
* Serve as the operational business point of contact for new carrier integrations and fulfillment capabilities.

3\. CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL GOVERNANCE \& STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT


* Establish effective regional governance to provide transparent, audience\-tailored visibility into delivery performance, operational milestones, and risk mitigation.
* Collaborate closely with SCM and Warehouse teams to influence fulfillment and carrier performance, ensuring agreed service levels are met.
* Partner with Customer Service to identify recurring post\-order friction points and optimize processes for faster, more effective consumer issue resolution.
* Collaborate with eCommerce Platform Operations, CS, CX, Planning, Analytics, Service Management, and Partner Program teams to deliver end\-to\-end operational improvements.

4\. DATA, SYSTEMS \& OPERATIONAL PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT


* Utilize OmniHub, Kibana, and operational analytics tools to monitor order backlogs, track exceptions, evaluate performance, and conduct root\-cause analysis.
* Develop and maintain clear operational dashboards, reports, and structured governance routines.
* Partner with Digital Innovation and Product/Technology teams to translate operational requirements into scalable system and platform enhancements.
* Modernize Post\-Order Operations through simplification, automation, data insights, and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Explore AI\-driven opportunities across exception management, operational insights, predictive issue identification, workflow automation, and decision support.

5\. PEOPLE MANAGEMENT \& LEADERSHIP


* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing team of Post\-Order Operations professionals.
* Establish clear objectives, shared accountability, and transparent performance expectations across the team.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and consumer\-centric decision\-making.
* Provide steady, supportive leadership during high\-volume trading moments and dynamic operational conditions.

KEY RELATIONSHIPS


* Cluster \& Hub SCM, Logistics, and Warehouse Teams
* Emerging Markets eCommerce Platform Operations, CS, Planning, CX, Analytics, and Partner Program
* Cluster eCommerce Leads and Teams
* IT Service Management Teams
* Digital Innovation and Programs Teams
* Global eCommerce \& Digital Product Teams

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES


* In\-depth understanding of the end\-to\-end eCommerce journey from click to delivery, including returns and reverse logistics.
* Strong knowledge of eCommerce post\-order operations, fulfillment workflows, and supporting technology architectures (OMS, WMS, TMS, and carrier platforms).
* Robust project management capabilities, including roadmap development, business requirements definition, milestone tracking, and operational handover.
* Strong understanding of processes at the intersection of business operations and IT systems.
* Proven ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders and drive outcomes collaboratively across a matrix organization.
* A star in prioritization based on consumer, business, and operational impact, combining detail orientation with an action\-focused mindset.
* Demonstrated vendor management experience within eCommerce fulfillment.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical capabilities to monitor performance metrics and extract actionable consumer insights.
* Highly developed interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal) to engage effectively across organizational levels.
* High adaptability in navigating evolving business processes, priorities, and partner ecosystems under tight timelines.

REQUISITE EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE / MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS


* 10\+ years of overall professional experience, including 7\+ years in eCommerce or Supply Chain Management (with preferred focus in eCommerce Fulfillment).
* Demonstrated experience delivering carrier/delivery service integrations and fulfillment capability rollouts.
* Extensive working experience with Microsoft Excel, Order Management Systems (OMS), Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), and Transportation Management Systems (TMS).
* Proven experience driving process optimization, workflow automation, and technology\-enabled operational transformation.
* Familiarity with practical AI applications within eCommerce operations is highly desirable.
* University degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

description:
**Role description** **About Cimpress**



Founded in 1994, Cimpress is now a group of 12\+ most innovative mass customization e\-commerce businesses in the world such as Vistaprint, National Pen, Pixart Printing, Exaprint, Printi, Drukwerkdeal, WIRmachenDRUCK, VIDA operating in



25 countries with a vast product range, world class automated manufacturing capabilities, and over $3\.5 billion in revenue.



At Cimpress, we drive competitive advantage across our various businesses by investing centrally in a select few shared strategic capabilities that have the greatest potential to create company\-wide value. Cimpress India is one such key strategic enterprise focused on building great teams in India across the domains of engineering, design, and artwork processing for various Cimpress businesses driving innovation.



\*\*Cimpress India\*\* began its journey in April 2017 and we now have 2000\+ great minds in Mumbai and Bengaluru working across various areas of software engineering as well as graphic design and prepress services for several different Cimpress businesses. With multi million customers, our teams are constantly challenging themselves to empower our businesses to be more entrepreneurial through our cutting\-edge technology solutions. Our teams work directly with our businesses around the world to solve complex customer demands through e\-commerce and manufacturing capabilities. Our primary engineering focus is to build products that are scalable and provide an impact and we need great talent like you to come and help us succeed.



**What is this opportunity about?**



We are seeking a personable, experienced human resources business partner to join our growing organization. In this position, you will primarily act as a consultant for company management on all issues related to human resources. You should be a proactive communicator and change agent, someone who can successfully balance employee needs with business objectives to create integrated solutions.



**Note: Looking for Candidates based out of Ahmedabad Location only.**



**What should you expect as an employee of Cimpress?**


* Truly global and open culture.
* Collaborative workplace with a bunch of brilliant minds as your colleagues, peers and coworkers.
* Sponsorship for entrepreneurial mindset and high ownership.
* Flexible work timings.
* Tremendous opportunities for learning new technologies.
* Encouragement for innovation and creativity.
* Competitive healthcare beneﬁts and many more.


**What are you expected to do?**


* Collect, track, and analyze basic HR metrics (turnover, engagement scores, exit trends) to identify operational gaps and recommend incremental process improvements.
* Serve as a trusted first point of contact for employees regarding queries, grievances, workplace ethics, and policies. Address day\-to\-day conflict resolution with guidance and neutrality.
* Support the execution of the annual HR cycle, including objective setting, mid\-year/annual performance reviews, and merit administration, ensuring compliance with established guidelines.
* Coordinate and champion employee engagement, well\-being, and Diversity \& Inclusion (D\&I) initiatives to build a positive, collaborative, and productive work environment.
* Assist Senior HRBPs and managers in executing team\-level people strategies, policy rollout, and organizational changes.
* Participate in HR project workstreams, ensuring task\-level deliverables and timelines are met consistently.


**What will make your candidature great?**


* Ability to analyze operational HR issues using established procedures and recommend practical solutions.
* Clear, empathetic, and effective communication skills to interact comfortably with team members and mid\-level managers.
* High sense of accountability, curiosity to learn company processes, and ability to handle standard workplace situations independently.
* Strong team\-player attitude with an ability to build positive working relationships across functions.

**Qualiﬁcation**


* Post\-graduate or Master’s degree preferably in HR.
* 4\+ years of experience in a core HR Business Partner / Employee Relations role.
* Previous experience in Employee Engagement, Talent Management,Training and Development is a plus.


**Location**



We are a Remote First Organisation, however this role will require travel to Ahmedabad Office.



**Why You'll Love Working Here:**



Being at Cimpress means that you don’t see work as just a building, a desk or a manufacturing floor. You see it as a chance to take a step forward in your career journey \- and your life. We strive to give you everything you need to learn, grow, and succeed. Through innovation, collaboration, and perpetual exposure to what’s next, we’re always pushing boundaries and broadening our horizons. We embrace the chance to operate outside of our comfort zone to discover what we’re capable of. Some might call that a challenge; we just call it another great day at work.



**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national or ethnic origin, nationality, age, religion, citizenship, disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender presentation, legal or preferred name, marital status, pregnancy, family structure, veteran status or any other basis protected by human rights laws or regulations. This list is not exhaustive and, in fact, in many cases, we strive to do more than the law requires.

title: Employee Relations Business Partner, India (Contractor)
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------


Rippling is looking for an Employee Relations Business Partner based in Bangalore, India to join its HR Policy \& Compliance Team to manage employee relations investigations.


You will work closely with a number of stakeholders, including HR Business Partners (HRBPs), Legal, and business leaders, on employee relations investigations.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Assess incoming employee relations concerns, determine the appropriate investigative response, and partner with stakeholders to drive timely and thoughtful resolution.
* Partner closely with Legal to identify and escalate matters requiring a dedicated Legal team investigation.
* Work with HR Business Partners, managers, and business leaders to resolve employee relations matters in a way that is fair, consistent, risk\-aware, and operationally practical.
* Provide practical HR guidance and recommendations that address employee concerns while supporting team effectiveness, manager accountability, and business continuity.
* Draft clear, concise documentation, including case summaries, findings, recommendations, stakeholder updates, playbooks, templates, and business\-facing guidance.
* Track employee relations activity, themes, resolution status, and outcomes in Rippling.
* Identify patterns, root causes, and emerging risks across employee relations matters, and recommend process, training, manager coaching, or policy improvements.
* Help develop and maintain employee relations operating practices, including intake criteria, escalation guidelines, documentation standards, investigation protocols, templates, and cadences.
* Leverage data, AI, and automation to improve employee relations processes, scale case handling, and create better experiences for employees and managers.
* Maintain discretion, confidentiality, neutrality, and professionalism when handling sensitive employee and workplace matters.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 5\+ years of experience in employee relations, HR business partnership, HR compliance, workplace investigations, or a related HR role.
* Strong understanding of employee relations principles, workplace conduct standards, HR compliance considerations, and investigation best practices.
* Experience advising managers and business leaders on sensitive employee matters with sound judgment, discretion, neutrality, and empathy.
* Ability to assess employee relations concerns and determine the right path for HR\-led resolution, stakeholder partnership, or escalation to Legal, Compliance, Security, or another specialized team.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting case summaries, findings, recommendations, playbooks, and stakeholder updates.
* Strong interviewing, fact\-gathering, documentation, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.
* Practical business judgment and strong HR instincts, with the ability to recommend solutions that are fair, consistent, risk\-aware, and operationally realistic.
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple matters at once, prioritize urgent issues, and drive work to timely resolution.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with HRBPs, Legal, managers, executives, and other internal stakeholders.
* Ability to use data and case trends to identify recurring issues, improve processes, and support broader employee relations priorities.
* Comfort building structure, improving processes, and operating effectively in a fast\-moving, high\-growth environment.
* Interest in using AI and automation to scale HR processes and improve the employee and manager experience.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Law degree, such as a JD or equivalent.
* Experience with Jira, case\-management systems, HRIS tools, or similar tracking platforms.
* Experience supporting a global or multi\-state workforce.
* Experience building employee relations programs, operating models, templates, or playbooks in a scaling company.

description:
**About Techdome**
------------------


Techdome is a product\-driven technology company building AI\-first platforms across Healthcare, FinTech, HRTech, Enterprise Automation, and Payments.  

At Techdome, hiring is more than filling open positions. It is about identifying exceptional talent, creating an outstanding candidate experience, and building high\-performing teams that contribute to innovation and business growth.

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who can independently manage the complete recruitment lifecycle — from understanding hiring requirements and sourcing quality talent to interview coordination, offer management, and successful onboarding.
In this role, you will work closely with Hiring Managers, Engineering Leaders, Product Teams, and Business Stakeholders to build strong talent pipelines and deliver a seamless candidate experience.**AI\-First Recruitment**

* ChatGPT
* Claude

* Perplexity

* Candidate Sourcing

* Interview Preparation
* Job Description Creation
* Candidate Communication

* Experience handling salary discussions, negotiations, and offer closures.

* Strong ownership, accountability, follow\-up, and attention to detail.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.

title: Manager, Legal
description:
Job description:

CACTUS is a remote\-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
We are a dynamic \& centralized team of talented Legal professionals. The Manager, Legal, will be part of this centralized team, assisting in legal operations for CACTUS and its overseas entities. One of the most exciting parts of this role is the opportunity to work on diverse assignments and exposure to various legal and compliance matters on a global scale making it a unique opportunity for dynamic legal professionals.  


Job responsibilities:
* Contract Management: Draft, review, negotiate, and finalize business contracts (MSAs, vendor agreements, NDAs, lease deeds, etc.) and optimize contract processes using technology.
* Legal Advisory \& Risk Management: Provide actionable legal advice, identify risks, and develop mitigation strategies for business initiatives.
* Project Management: Independently manage legal workstreams and projects, co\-ordinate with cross\-functional stakeholders, and drive matters to timely closure.
* Compliance \& Policy: Develop and monitor corporate policies, ensure regulatory compliance across jurisdictions, and stay updated on legislative changes.
* Data Privacy: Advice on compliance with global data protection laws (e.g., GDPR, DPDPA) and standardize data handling practices.
* Intellectual Property: Manage IP protection, enforcement, and filings; draft IP\-related clauses and notices.
* Litigation: Handle legal notices, pre\-litigation matters, and coordinate with external counsel for litigation.
* Employment \& Labor Laws: Experience in employment and labour law, with the ability to advise on employment\-related matters and support HR and business stakeholders on practical legal and compliance requirements.
* Operational Excellence: Drive process improvement, standardization, and automation across legal operations, including developing SOPs, templates, workflows, trackers, and other tools to improve efficiency and consistency.


Qualifications and prerequisites:
* Bachelor of Law (LLB) with work experience of 8\-10 years.
* Business Partnering, working closely with internal teams to address legal concerns and provide practical solutions that align with business objectives.
* Strong communication skills to simplify legal concepts for non\-legal teams.
* Ability to independently manage projects, priorities, stakeholders, and high volumes in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong organizational and multi\-tasking skills with attention to detail.
* Fast closure and efficiency.
* Exceptional drafting, negotiation, and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated expertise in international corporate and contractual laws.
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Highly motivated, independent, with a quality and results\-oriented mindset.


Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised.Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, there will be 2\-3 rounds of interview including an in\-person meeting (for Mumbai based candidates).

**Equal Opportunity**


Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

**Accelerating from Anywhere**


As a remote\-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.


About Us:

Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI\-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting\-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Future Begins Here**


At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future\-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.


Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.

Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team


About the role:


The Sourcing Associate is responsible for sourcing goods and services for various business processes within the organization. This role involves Sourcing Execution \& RfX, Management Market \& Supplier Research, Contract \& Supplier Administration, Data Analysis \& KPI Reporting, Value Delivery \& Governance. This role supports Takeda's mission of delivering better health to people and a brighter future to the world.


How you will contribute:

* Execute RFI, RFP, and RFQ processes for defined Indirect and Commercial Indirect categories (e.g. Professional Services, HR, Facilities, Sales \& Marketing) or spend thresholds under guidance of the Sourcing Lead.
* Support the Source\-to\-Contract process through market research, spend analysis, proposal evaluation, and contract management.
* Lead negotiations with suppliers, driving value and competitive advantage to Takeda.
* Will have a primary anchor position but would be expected to flex and work across other categories as appropriate

**ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

**Sourcing Execution \& RfX Management**

* Engagement with operational stakeholders presenting requirements for sourcing, as well as category strategies developed by category managers
* Execute RFI, RFP, and RFQ events for Indirect and Commercial Indirect categories under Sourcing Lead guidance, adhering to Takeda procurement policies. Flexibility to work in other categories too
* Prepare sourcing documentation: scope of work, supplier questionnaires, evaluation criteria, and tender packages
* Manage supplier communication during sourcing events; coordinate Q\&A and maintain event trackers in SAP Ariba
* Ensure all sourcing activities are documented accurately and completed within agreed timelines
* Partner with supporting functions for execution of activities

**Market \& Supplier Research**

* Conduct supplier market research and maintain up\-to\-date supplier landscape knowledge across assigned Indirect and Commercial Indirect categories
* Identify and evaluate potential new suppliers; gather capability, compliance, and pricing information
* Gather pricing benchmarks and market intelligence to support category strategy and sourcing recommendations in SAP Ariba

**Contract \& Supplier Administration**

* Support contract drafting, review coordination, and approval workflows per Takeda Legal and Compliance requirements
* Maintain contract records; monitor renewals, expirations, and performance milestones
* Support supplier onboarding, due diligence, and ethical sourcing compliance checks

**Data Analysis \& KPI Reporting**

* Analyze supplier proposals and prepare structured, objective evaluation summaries for Sourcing Lead review
* Conduct spend analysis to identify savings opportunities; feed findings into the category savings pipeline
* Support KPI monitoring to help the team track procurement's contribution; maintain data accuracy

**Value Delivery \& Governance**

* Contribute to delivery of savings targets by identifying value opportunities within assigned Indirect and Commercial Indirect categories, as well as in other categories
* Ensure all sourcing activities comply with Takeda procurement policies, SOPs, and governance standards
* Support preferred supplier utilization initiatives

**Interface to Operational Procurement (Procurement Solutions)**

* Collaborate with operational buyers in Central Finance on execution and service delivery
* Ensure smooth handover of sourcing inputs and outputs for operational RfX execution

**EDUCATION, BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's Degree in relevant field

**Behavioural:**


As members of Global Procurement, you are expected to demonstrate ways of working that support our strategic ambition and shape how we create value for Takeda. You will contribute to a procurement function that:

* Shapes strategy upstream through close business partnership
* Deliver total enterprise value beyond savings
* Takes ownership of spend and outcomes end to end
* Uses curiosity, insights, and data to drive better decisions


These principles define how we partner with the business, our suppliers, and each other. Role\-specific examples of these behaviors are embedded throughout the objectives, accountability, and skills outlined in this job description.

**Competencies and skills:**

* **Experience:** 4\+ years of procurement, sourcing, or supply chain experience, preferably in a Lifesciences, professional services, or marketing/commercial environment. Exposure to RFI/RFP/RFQ processes and supplier evaluation preferred. Pharmaceutical, biotech, or professional services/marketing services experience an advantage. Sourcing experience across the indirect categories.

 **Technical skills:**

* Understanding of Source\-to\-Contract processes, procurement guidelines, and supplier management principles
* Basic familiarity with Indirect and Commercial Indirect categories
* Proficiency with eSourcing tools (SAP Ariba preferred) and strong data skills in Excel / Google Sheets
* Ability to analyze supplier proposals and prepare structured evaluation summaries and attention to detail; strong organizational skills; ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Enthusiasm for digital and AI improvements in procurement ways of working.
* Collaborative and diplomatic, with demonstrated track record of operating successfully with limited day\-to\-day direction and ambiguity.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills both oral and written.
* Extensive experience using Microsoft desk top applications (e.g. PowerPoint, Excel) and experienced with using Generative / Agentic AI
* **Languages**: Fluent written and spoken English

**BENEFITS:**


It is our priority to provide competitive compensation and a benefit package that bridges your personal life with your professional career. Amongst our benefits are:

* Competitive Salary \+ Performance Annual Bonus

title: Sourcing Manager
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Future Begins Here**


At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future\-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.


Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.

**At Takeda’s ICC we Unite in Diversity**


Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team.

**About the Role**  

The Procurement, Senior Manager is responsible for obtaining goods and services for various business processes within the organization. This role focuses on Sourcing Strategy \& Execution, Business Partnering \& Stakeholder Engagement, Supplier \& Market Management, Standardization \& Process Excellence, Supplier \& Risk Management, Negotiation \& Contracting, Value Delivery \& Governance. This role supports Takeda's mission of delivering better health and a brighter future.


How you will contribute:

* Drive end\-to\-end Source\-to\-Contract process for defined Indirect and Commercial Indirect categories (e.g. Professional Services, HR, Facilities, Sales \& Marketing) or spend thresholds.
* Develop and execute sourcing strategies aligned with Global Category Manager direction and business needs.
* Identify and drive value levers (cost, demand, innovation, risk, ESG); support Category Managers to drive value.
* Lead negotiations with suppliers, driving value and competitive advantage to Takeda.
* Accountability and ownership on relationships with suppliers and stakeholders, when managed by the value delivery team.
* Will have a primary anchor position related to a specific category but would be expected to flex and work in other categories as appropriate

**ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

**Sourcing Strategy \& Execution**

* Develop and own sourcing strategies for Indirect and Commercial Indirect categories aligned with business priorities and category strategies
* Identify and drive value levers (cost, demand, innovation, risk, ESG)
* Prepare sourcing events and align with Central Finance on RfX execution
* Maintain the project pipeline in Wave; drive continuous improvement against quality targets

**Business Partnering \& Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as primary procurement interface for Marketing, Sales, HR, Facilities, and other indirect
* business stakeholders in sourcing
* Challenge demand, specifications, and sourcing approaches constructively
* Socialize procurement best practices (preferred suppliers, SoW optimization, BuyEasy@Takeda etc.)
* Collaborate with business partners, Procurement CoE, Finance, and Takeda Business Solutions

**Supplier \& Market Management**

* Build deep understanding of CRO, lab services, and pharma sciences supplier markets and industry trends
* Support supplier selection decisions, segmentation, and performance governance
* Support strategic supplier relationships and escalate risks to Sourcing Lead
* **Standardization \& Process Excellence**
* Implement and enforce standardized sourcing templates, playbooks, and workflows
* Identify opportunities for automation with digital and AI for process optimization and simplification

**Supplier \& Risk Management**

* Own supplier relationships, governance, and performance management across the Indirect and Commercial Indirect portfolio
* Identify and mitigate supply chain risks to ensure business continuity and patient supply security
* Develop contingency plans and alternative sourcing strategies for critical Indirect and Commercial Indirect categories

**Negotiation \& Contracting**

* Lead negotiations and contract finalization for assigned sourcing events within defined thresholds
* Define negotiation strategies using should\-cost models and benchmarks
* Ensure alignment with Category Manager, Legal, Finance, and risk frameworks

**Value Delivery \& Governance**

* Support delivery of savings targets and value realization (cost, demand, innovation, risk, ESG)
* Contribute to supplier risk management and compliance
* Ensure alignment with Takeda procurement policies and governance standards
* Drive CI and performance management of KPI’s

**Interface to Operational Procurement (Procurement Solutions)**

* Collaborate with operational buyers in Central Finance on execution and service delivery
* Ensure smooth handover of sourcing inputs and outputs for operational RfX execution

**EDUCATION, BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS:**

*Education:*

* Bachelor’s degree in relevant field

*Behavioural:*


As members of Global Procurement, you are expected to demonstrate ways of working that support our strategic ambition and shape how we create value for Takeda. You will contribute to a procurement function that:

* Shapes strategy upstream through close business partnership
* Deliver total enterprise value beyond savings
* Takes ownership of spend and outcomes end to end
* Uses curiosity, insights, and data to drive better decisions


These principles define how we partner with the business, our suppliers, and each other. Role\-specific examples of these behaviors are embedded throughout the objectives, accountability, and skills outlined in this job description.

***Competencies and skills:***

**Experience:** 7\+ years in procurement, sourcing, or shared services with strong exposure to professional services, HR, facilities, or sales \& marketing categories, preferably in Lifesciences.

 **Technical skills:**

* In\-depth knowledge of strategic sourcing with ability to leverage digital and AI improvements in ways of working
* Strong commercial acumen and negotiation experience; ability to define strategies using should\-cost models and benchmarks for professional services and marketing spend
* Experience managing complex business stakeholders across Clinical Operations, Pharma Sciences, Finance, Legal, and Business Units
* Proficiency with SAP Ariba or equivalent eSourcing tools; experience with Wave pipeline management.
* Experience working in a complex global environment preferred.
* Exceptionally skilled at stakeholder management.
* Proven ability to manage senior, cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Collaborative and diplomatic, with demonstrated track record of operating successfully with limited day\-to\-day direction and ambiguity.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills both oral and written.
* Extensive experience using Microsoft desk top applications (e.g. PowerPoint, Excel) and experienced with using Generative / Agentic AI
* **Languages**: Fluent written and spoken English

**BENEFITS:**


It is our priority to provide competitive compensation and a benefit package that bridges your personal life with your professional career. Amongst our benefits are:

* Competitive Salary \+ Performance Annual Bonus
* Flexible work environment, including hybrid working
* Comprehensive Healthcare Insurance Plans for self, spouse, and children
* Group Term Life Insurance and Group Accident Insurance programs
* Employee Assistance Program
* Broad Variety of learning platforms
* Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Programs
* Reimbursements – Home Internet \& Mobile Phone
* Employee Referral Program
* Leaves – Paternity Leave (4 Weeks) , Maternity Leave (up to 26 weeks), Bereavement Leave (5 calendar days)

**ABOUT ICC IN TAKEDA:**

* Takeda is leading a digital revolution. We’re not just transforming our company; we’re improving the lives of millions of patients who rely on our medicines every day.
* As an organization, we are committed to our cloud\-driven business transformation and believe the ICCs are the catalysts of change for our global organization.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**Enterprise Customer Success Manager (Bilingual)**
---------------------------------------------------



MariaDB is making a big impact on the world. Whether you're checking your bank account, buying a coffee, shopping online, making a phone call, listening to music, taking out a loan or ordering takeout – MariaDB is the backbone of applications used everyday. Companies small and large, including 75% of the Fortune 500, run MariaDB, touching the lives of billions of people. With massive reach through Linux distributions, enterprise deployments and public clouds, MariaDB is uniquely positioned as the leading database for modern application development.


**Summary**
-----------



The Customer Success Manager will be responsible for the long\-term success, value, and retention of their customer portfolio utilizing our MariaDB database solutions. Leveraging their **English language skills**, they will strengthen and manage the partnership between customers and the company, interacting regularly to build relationships, drive adoption, and provide awareness to all available resources. Through collaboration, they will educate customers to achieve their business goals and maximize value from their investment in our MariaDB solutions. The CSM is the primary point of contact for escalations and is responsible for working in collaboration with a team of Sales Engineers, Account Executives, and other cross\-functional teams, focused on helping our customers achieve their business goals.


**Key Strategic \& Retention Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------------


* Support and engage with customers throughout all stages of their customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, expansion, retention, and advocacy.
* Guide new customers through onboarding for MariaDB deployments, consulting on MariaDB best practices to ensure customers receive value.
* Formulate an ongoing meeting cadence with the assigned portfolio.
* Become a trusted advisor and advocate for customers within the company.
* Understand customers' data management strategies and effectively articulate additional improvements and/or new strategies leveraging MariaDB capabilities.
* Identify proactive opportunities to work with and provide value to customers.
* Proactively address customer experience issues early, collaborating with Technical Support to understand their customer's issue, and assisting as an escalation point of contact.
* Work with Sales Engineers and Professional Services to determine appropriate services for MariaDB upgrades, migrations, deployments, and/or maintenance.
* Conduct regular business reviews within accounts, showcasing value and learning about business goals and priorities.
* Encourage customer participation in company initiatives (Webinars, Roadshows, Product Feedback, etc).
* Responsible for measuring, managing, and improving customer health, engagement, and value realization.
* Coordinate with Account Executives to ensure the upgrade, migration, and/or growth of the customer portfolio.
* Articulate growth plans, expectations, and successes; documented and tracked within success plans.
* Effectively communicate customer needs to other parts of the business and act as a customer champion within the company.
* Work collaboratively and influence other departments to promote customer satisfaction and success.
* Manage and maintain customer portfolio in achieving the company's Net Retention goals.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* 2\-4 Years of experience in customer facing roles within enterprise software
* **Fluent in and ability to speak and write in English**
* Always represent the company in a knowledgeable and professional manner.
* Possess a mix of technical acumen, intellectual curiosity, and interpersonal relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent time management and organization skills.
* Ability to develop and maintain C\-Level relationships.
* Ability to deliver custom ROI analysis for your customer portfolio.
* Comprehensive understanding of customer success principles.
* Strong understanding of MariaDB features, architecture, and common use cases in enterprise solutions.
* Can speak to new features and quickly speak to new releases of MariaDB.
* High attention to detail.
* Proficient in identifying and understanding complex business needs as it relates to MariaDB.


**Location** \- India (Remote)


**Travel** \- Up to 40% within region


### **What's in it for you?**



Impact the world of technology by pushing the boundaries of technology and business models, working at MariaDB, plc. Be part of a game\-changing organization that encourages outside\-the\-box thinking, values empowerment, and is truly shaping the future of the software industry. You'll be collaborating with high\-caliber colleagues around the world, offering unparalleled learning and growth opportunities. We provide a very competitive compensation package, 25 days paid annual leave (plus holidays) and a massive degree of flexibility and freedom, and more.



Salaries for candidates outside the U.S. will vary based on local compensation structures.


**How to Apply**
----------------



If you are interested in this position, please submit your application along with your CV/Resume through our ATS Greenhouse on our MariaDB Careers site.


* At MariaDB we celebrate the diverse experiences and perspectives of our employees because this drives innovation and success. MariaDB is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to creating a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone.
* MariaDB does not sponsor work visas or relocation.
* MariaDB is committed to providing accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
* MariaDB will not accept agency resumes without a prior contractual agreement with HR. Please do not forward resumes to any recruiting alias or employee directly. MariaDB is not responsible for paying any fees associated with any unsolicited submitted CV/Resumes.

title: Account Executive
description:
Accounts Executive – Operations, Payroll \& Statutory Compliance

**Department:** Finance \& Accounts  
**Experience:** 2–5 years  
**Location:** Remote  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reporting To:** Finance Manager / Management

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Accounts Executive** to manage day\-to\-day accounting operations, payroll processing, employee\-related statutory compliances, and taxation activities. The candidate will be responsible for accurate and timely processing of salaries, PF, ESI, Professional Tax (PT), TDS, GST, accounting entries, reconciliations, and statutory filings.

Key Responsibilities1\. Accounting Operations

* Handle day\-to\-day accounting entries and maintain books of accounts.
* Manage accounts payable and receivable.
* Prepare invoices, payment vouchers, receipts, and expense records.
* Maintain ledgers and perform bank and ledger reconciliations.
* Track outstanding receivables and payables.
* Assist with monthly and annual closing of accounts.
* Maintain proper documentation for audits and statutory requirements.
* Work on **Tally / ERP / accounting software** and Excel.

2\. Payroll Management

* Handle **end\-to\-end monthly payroll processing**.
* Collect and verify attendance, leave, overtime, incentives, reimbursements, and other payroll inputs.
* Calculate salaries, deductions, allowances, incentives, and reimbursements.
* Calculate and process **PF, ESI, PT and TDS deductions**.
* Prepare payroll registers and salary statements.
* Generate and distribute employee payslips.
* Process Full \& Final (F\&F) settlements for employees leaving the organization.
* Maintain employee payroll records and resolve payroll\-related queries.

3\. PF, ESI \& Professional Tax

* Handle monthly **PF calculations, challans and ECR filing**.
* Manage ESI calculations, payments, and applicable filings.
* Handle **Professional Tax (PT)** calculations, payments, and returns as applicable by state.
* Ensure employee PF/ESI registrations and updates are completed correctly.
* Maintain statutory records and documentation.
* Ensure all statutory payments and filings are completed within due dates.

4\. TDS \& Tax Compliance

* Calculate monthly **TDS** on salaries and applicable vendor payments.
* Prepare TDS workings and reconciliations.
* Make timely TDS payments.
* Prepare and coordinate quarterly TDS returns, including **Form 24Q** where applicable.
* Support preparation/issuance of employee **Form 16**.
* Handle employee income\-tax declarations and investment proofs.
* Coordinate with tax consultants and auditors when required.

5\. GST \& Other Compliance

* Assist with GST data preparation, reconciliation, payments, and returns.
* Reconcile purchase/sales data with accounting records.
* Maintain GST and tax\-related documentation.
* Coordinate with consultants for statutory filings and notices.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour and tax regulations.

6\. Operations \& MIS

* Coordinate with HR and Operations for attendance, employee master data, joining, exits, and payroll inputs.
* Prepare monthly payroll and finance MIS reports.
* Prepare salary cost, headcount, statutory liability, and expense reports.
* Reconcile payroll with accounting/GL records.
* Monitor statutory payment and filing calendars.
* Support management with financial and operational reports.

7\. Audit \& Documentation

* Maintain proper accounting, payroll, tax, and statutory records.
* Provide documents and schedules required for internal/statutory audits.
* Coordinate with auditors, consultants, banks, and government authorities when required.
* Ensure confidentiality of employee salary and financial information.

Required Qualifications

* **B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance** or equivalent.
* **2–5 years of relevant experience** in Accounts, Payroll and Statutory Compliance.
* Strong practical knowledge of **Indian payroll and statutory compliance**.
* Hands\-on experience with **PF, ESI, PT, TDS and GST**.
* Good knowledge of **Tally/ERP and MS Excel**.
* Strong reconciliation and numerical skills.
* Ability to independently manage monthly payroll and compliance deadlines.

Preferred Skills

* Advanced Excel – VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, reconciliations, MIS.
* Tally Prime / ERP / payroll software experience.
* Good knowledge of Indian accounting and taxation.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to coordinate with HR, Operations, employees, auditors and consultants.
* Ability to work under strict monthly statutory and payroll deadlines.
