title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**About Avahi**
 Avahi Inc. is a rapidly growing startup and an AWS Advanced Tier Partner, specializing in providing cutting\-edge cloud solutions and professional services. Our mission is to drive digital transformation and cloud adoption for our clients, leveraging AWS's extensive suite of services.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Technical Project Manager to join our team. The successful candidate will own customer communication and manage the entire project lifecycle for enterprise cloud engagements, ensuring successful delivery of cloud and GenAI solutions. This role requires a proactive leader with a strong technical background, structured project management discipline, senior\-stakeholder management skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Customer Communication: Own and manage all customer communications throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring transparency and satisfaction.
* Stakeholder Management: Independently identify, engage, and manage stakeholders across the customer organization — including business, technical, and executive stakeholders — rather than relying on a single point of contact for requirements or direction.
* Project Kickoff and Onboarding: Schedule and facilitate internal and kickoff calls, onboard the team and customers for project delivery.
* Project Management: Create and manage the lifecycle of projects using Jira boards, ensuring all tasks are tracked and completed on time.
* Structured Status Reporting: Drive daily and weekly status communication using structured PM frameworks such as RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), RAG (Red/Amber/Green) status, and YTB (Yesterday/Today/Blockers) — rather than unstructured, plain\-text updates.
* Timely Updates: Provide regular, consolidated project updates to leadership, customers, and AWS sellers, ensuring all stakeholders are informed.
* Timesheet Review and Approval: Review and approve delivery team timesheets to ensure accurate billing and project tracking.
* Team Allocation: Update allocation boards for teams in Clockify, ensuring efficient resource management.
* Project Ownership: Be the project owner, driving delivery for successful outcomes and customer satisfaction.
* KPI Management: Drive the three key KPIs: keeping the project within budget, ensuring timely delivery, and achieving CSAT scores of 8 and above — with the ability to clearly explain the process and metrics used to achieve these outcomes.
* Multi\-Project Management: Take on and manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring all are delivered successfully.
* Project Retrospectives: Conduct retrospectives for projects as needed to identify areas for improvement and ensure continuous improvement.
* Scope Management: Recognize changes in project scope and facilitate the creation of change orders to manage project changes effectively.
* Budget and Timeline Tracking: Keep track of and drive project budgets and timelines, ensuring financial and temporal goals are met.
* Risk Management: Manage a risk register and develop mitigation plans to address potential project risks proactively.


**Requirements**
 Experience
   

  

* Extensive experience managing AWS professional services engagements, with a proven track record of owning delivery for complex, high\-value, multi\-stakeholder projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing enterprise clients (large, multi\-stakeholder customer organizations) — able to speak in specific, verifiable detail about the engagements, budgets, and stakeholders involved.
* Proven, explainable track record of on\-time delivery and CSAT outcomes — candidates should be able to walk through the actual process, tools, and metrics used to achieve any delivery/CSAT numbers cited on their resume.
* Experience working with Jira for project management.
* Familiarity with Clockify or similar time\-tracking tools is a plus.


 Project Management Skills
   

  

* Working knowledge of core PM frameworks used for status reporting and risk tracking — RAID, RAG, and YTB — and ability to apply them in daily/weekly stakeholder communication.
* Strong, independent stakeholder management skills: able to gather requirements directly from multiple stakeholders (not solely through a single technical escalation point such as a CTO), manage competing priorities, and communicate consolidated (not plain\-text) updates.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with customers and internal teams at all levels, including executives.


 Technical \& GenAI Awareness
   

  

* Solid technical understanding of the AWS services relevant to the projects being managed, with the ability to explain project architecture and delivery approach beyond a surface level.
* Working awareness of GenAI fundamentals and modern agentic frameworks (e.g., multi\-agent orchestration concepts) sufficient to manage GenAI\-related delivery workstreams and speak credibly with technical stakeholders.


**Certifications (Preferred)**
* AWS Cloud Practitioner certification preferred.
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) preferred.


**Benefits**
 Why Join Avahi?
   

  

* Be part of a fast\-moving startup with a dynamic and collaborative culture.
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AWS technologies and drive meaningful cloud transformation for clients.
* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Professional growth and development opportunities.


 If you are a motivated and experienced Technical Project Manager with a passion for cloud technology and customer success, we encourage you to apply and join our innovative team at Avahi Inc.

****Job Description:****

You will guide 1–3 agile teams, encouraging a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and delivery excellence. Your leadership will help shape scalable solutions and ensure understanding of SAFe Agile practices, directly helping product improvement and business growth. * Team Empowerment \& Delivery: Support teams in and cross\-functional collaboration. Remove impediments and ensure delivery of sprint goals and program increments.
* Project Management Support: Assist in schedule management, risk assessment, and effort estimation. Maintain project plans and track progress toward key milestones.
* Dependency \& Stakeholder Coordination: Facilitate coordination with other agile teams and communicate status of inter\-team dependencies.
* Continuous Improvement: Promote a learning culture by implementing process enhancements. Share best practices across teams and mentor junior Scrum Masters or team members.


****The Essentials – You Will Have:****
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–5\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master in a product\-based company, managing cross\-functional teams across hardware, firmware, software, and mechanical domains.
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM or equivalent).
* Ability to manage continuation/sustenance and new product design projects.


****The Preferred – You Might Also Have:****
* 4\+ years of experience in software development, testing, or related technical roles
* Experience in Agile coaching or holding an Agile Coach certification.
* Prior leadership experience in Agile environments.
* Familiarity with Rockwell Automation products or other industrial control systems.
* Exposure to SAFe Agile framework and enterprise\-level Agile transformation initiatives.

+ Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
+ Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
+ Company volunteer and donation matching programs – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
+ Employee Assistance Program

title: Technical Scrum Master
description:
**Req ID:** 
 386147
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Technical Scrum Master to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
   

  

 1 \| Position Overview
   

  

 The Technical Scrum Master will lead agile delivery for the AWS Policy Master engineering pod and serve as the execution bridge among product owners, business and policy SMEs, solution architecture, data engineering, API, database, DevSecOps, and quality teams. The role combines strong Scrum facilitation with sufficient AWS and data\-engineering fluency to manage technical dependencies, remove impediments, maintain delivery transparency, and drive predictable releases across the S3–Lambda–SQS–Aurora–API flow. The individual will not act as the solution architect, but must be comfortable challenging plans, surfacing delivery risk, and translating technical progress into business\-ready status.
   

  

 2 \| Required Skills and Experience
   

  

* 8–10 years of overall technology delivery experience, including at least 4 years as a Scrum Master or agile delivery lead for data, cloud, integration, or application\-modernization teams.
* Strong working knowledge of Scrum and Kanban practices, sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, reviews, retrospectives, release planning, velocity, capacity, and dependency management.
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams spanning cloud data pipelines, APIs or microservices, database engineering, DevSecOps, automation testing, and production support.
* Practical understanding of AWS delivery concepts—S3, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, Aurora PostgreSQL, API Gateway, IAM, CloudWatch, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code—to facilitate informed technical planning and risk discussions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage cross\-team dependencies, RAID items, critical paths, nonfunctional requirements, environment readiness, testing gates, and release or cutover activities.
* Hands\-on experience with Jira and Confluence or equivalent agile lifecycle tools; ability to create actionable dashboards and concise executive status reports.
* Strong facilitation, conflict\-resolution, stakeholder\-management, written communication, and coaching skills; comfortable working across onsite and offshore teams and multiple time zones.
* Experience in insurance, policy administration, operational data stores, data mastering, or regulated financial\-services programs is strongly preferred.
* Scrum certification such as CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, or PMI\-ACP is preferred; AWS Cloud Practitioner or similar foundational cloud certification is an advantage.


 3 \| Duties
   

  

* Facilitate sprint ceremonies and ensure each sprint has clear objectives, prioritized stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, estimates, and accountable owners.
* Partner with the Product Owner and technical leads to maintain a healthy backlog covering ingestion, validation, buffering, transformation, canonical policy data, Aurora persistence, APIs, observability, security, and reliability.
* Build and maintain integrated sprint and release plans across AWS data engineering, Aurora data modeling, API engineering, DevSecOps, testing, business SMEs, and dependent source or consumer teams.
* Identify, track, and remove delivery impediments; escalate architecture, access, environment, data, security, vendor, or dependency blockers with clear impact and resolution dates.
* Monitor sprint predictability, throughput, carryover, defect trends, test progress, technical debt, and release readiness; convert metrics into practical corrective actions rather than administrative reporting.
* Coordinate technical design reviews, story readiness, definition\-of\-done adherence, nonfunctional requirement coverage, test evidence, production\-readiness reviews, and go/no\-go checkpoints.
* Facilitate decision\-making and conflict resolution while preserving clear accountability among the Product Owner, architects, engineering leads, and business stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives, root\-cause follow\-up, dependency reduction, automation opportunities, and consistent agile engineering practices.
* Provide concise weekly status covering accomplishments, upcoming milestones, risks, decisions, dependencies, staffing, and any impact to scope, schedule, quality, or cost.
* Support cutover, hypercare, incident triage, and post\-release reviews to ensure operational learning is incorporated into subsequent sprints.

description:
Studio Mesmer is a digital product design agency. We design the apps, dashboards, and websites our clients are proud to put in front of their own users, the kind of work where "it just feels right" is the highest compliment we get.
 



  





 We're hiring a UX/UI Designer to join our team. Experience level doesn't matter to us as much as skill and genuine passion for the craft. If you care about how things look, how they work, and why that difference matters, we want to hear from you.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Design UX/UI for real client products, from early wireframes through to polished, ship\-ready screens
* Translate open\-ended briefs into clear, well\-reasoned design decisions
* Build and maintain design systems, and use them consistently across projects
* Prototype ideas quickly so new concepts can be tested and discussed early
* Join client conversations and turn feedback into concrete design direction
* Pay close attention to the details that are easy to skip: micro\-interactions, empty states, error messages, and loading states

* A portfolio that shows your thinking and your craft. Student work, freelance projects, and professional client work are all welcome

* The ability to take feedback well and give it thoughtfully
* Genuine curiosity about design, and about how people use the things we build



  





 If you're early in your career, show us how you think. If you're more experienced, show us your process as well as your polish.

* A fully remote, full\-time role
* Real client work from the start
* A team that takes design seriously and enjoys the details as much as you do

 Adobe Express is reimagining how millions of people create with design intelligence at the centre of it. We're looking for an Experience Designer to help shape our Color and Styling workflows, as well as contribute to the AI Assistant experiences within Express. You'll work on the systems that help users discover their taste, build visual consistency, and bring color and style to their creations, increasingly powered by AI.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on design IC role for someone with solid craft and a growth mindset, who's excited to work at the intersection of creative tooling and AI. You'll partner closely with senior designers, product managers, and engineers to take ideas from concept to shipped experience.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Design end\-to\-end experiences for Color and Styling workflows in Adobe Express from sketches and wireframes to high\-fidelity mock\-ups and interactive prototypes.
* Contribute to AI Assistant workflows within Express, helping define how users interact with AI to style, refine, and personalize their work.
* Produce clear design documentation and communicate your rationale to teammates and cross\-functional partners.
* Participate in user research and usability testing, and fold those learnings back into your designs.
* Set your own deadlines within the project schedule and reliably deliver against them.
* Incorporate feedback from design leads, product managers, and collaborators, iterating quickly and exploring multiple solutions.
* Work within and contribute to Adobe's design system, helping keep experiences consistent and on\-brand.


 What you'll bring
   

  

**Must\-haves:**
* Solid design skills with strong attention to detail across interaction and visual design.
* High\-fidelity fluency in Figma, Adobe CC apps and AI tools, with the ability to produce wireframes, prototypes, and polished mock\-ups.
* An understanding of the product design lifecycle and the different phases of the design process.
* Genuine interest in color, styling and the craft of helping users make beautiful things.
* Curiosity about AI and how it can augment creative workflows.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, and a willingness to give and receive feedback constructively.
* A growth mindset and eagerness to broaden your skills and domain knowledge.


**Nice\-to\-haves:**

Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 The Enterprise Digital Product Office (EDPO) at Optum is a centralized organization focused on accelerating digital transformation across the enterprise. The team partners across business, technology, and operations to design, build, and scale product\-centric solutions that improve customer experiences, optimize operational workflows, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The team drives consistency in product strategy, agile delivery, and design practices, enabling teams to operate with greater speed, clarity, and impact. By aligning cross\-functional stakeholders and leveraging modern technologies\-including cloud platforms, data, and AI\-the organization supports the development of scalable, user\-centered solutions that help advance Optum's mission to build a more effective and equitable health care system.
   

  

 As a Product Designer, you'll contribute to the design of responsive web and mobile experiences, partnering with cross\-functional teams to transform user insights into thoughtful, accessible, and scalable solutions. You'll own the design execution of features, collaborate with experienced designers, and help deliver products that create meaningful outcomes for millions of users.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Partner with product managers, engineers, researchers, and fellow designers to deliver intuitive, user\-centered digital experiences.
* Providing design execution for our product portfolio that support our business and the interactions we have with Health Care Professionals (Providers)

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**About StarRez**
 StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off\-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400\+ clients across 25\+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user\-friendly, all\-in\-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.
   

  

**The Role** 
  

  

 As an UI/UX Designer, you'll own the design of complex, data‑rich experiences that support decision‑making for administrators and improve clarity and usability across our platform.
   

  

 You'll work as a senior individual contributor within a cross‑functional product team: Design, Product, Engineering, bringing deep UI/UX expertise to your product area. While Product Management owns roadmap direction and prioritisation, you will play a critical role in informing decisions through research, design exploration, and user‑centred evidence, translating complexity into intuitive, accessible solutions.
   

  

 This role sits within a newly established team focused on analytics, dashboards, and reporting, where you'll elevate usability, interaction design, and data visualisation quality across StarRez products.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Lead complex design initiatives from discovery through delivery, translating multi‑role, data‑heavy workflows into intuitive, scalable, and accessible experiences.
* Conduct and contribute to continuous discovery activities, including customer interviews, usability testing, and concept validation, surfacing insights that inform product decisions and reduce delivery risk.
* Partner with Product to support clear problem framing, hypotheses, and measures of success, using research, experimentation, and customer feedback to validate design decisions and iterate solutions.
* Work iteratively, shipping improvements in stages and refining designs based on real‑world usage, feedback, and observed outcomes.
* Elevate data visualisation quality across dashboards and reporting experiences, ensuring information is clear, meaningful, and usable for diverse audiences.
* Strengthen the broader product experience by contributing to our design system and embedding accessibility best practices (WCAG 2\.2 AA) in collaboration with Engineering.
* Support stakeholder alignment through clear communication of UX decisions, improving usability and consistency through hands‑on critique, shared UI/UX patterns, and informal mentorship.
* Actively leverage AI‑powered tools and workflows within the design practice to accelerate exploration, iteration, and problem‑solving.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience designing complex SaaS or B2B digital products.
* Strong experience designing data‑rich interfaces, including dashboards, reporting tools, or complex operational systems.
* Demonstrated experience contributing to measurable product or business impact through improved usability, efficiency, or user satisfaction.
* Strong systems thinking and experience working across interconnected workflows or multi\-role platforms.
* Proficiency in interaction design, information architecture, and high\-fidelity execution.
* Experience leading discovery efforts and synthesizing insights into actionable product decisions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate design rationale clearly to cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Experience partnering closely with Engineering to ensure high\-quality implementation.
* A strong sense of shared ownership, you care about outcomes, not just deliverables.
* Ability to balance speed with rigor, making thoughtful decisions grounded in research, data, and sound judgment.


  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in scale\-ups or growth\-stage product environments.
* Familiarity with accessibility standards, testing tools, and assistive technologies.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled workflows, automation, or design\-to\-development optimisation practices.


*Even if you don't have all of the Preferred Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!*
  

  

**Reasons to join our Team:** 
  

  

 StarRez is not just a workplace—it's a place to belong, build, and grow.
   

  

* A Culture That Lasts: Many of our team members have been with us for 20\+ years—a testament to our people\-first philosophy.
* Global Impact, Local Ownership: Join a team that spans across Australia, the USA, the UK, and Canada, working on industry\-leading solutions, while building the centre up from ground up.
* Long\-Term Vision: We're not here for short\-term gains. We invest in our people for the long haul, creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and thrive.
* Innovation with Stability: Backed by Vista Equity Partners, we combine the agility of a scaling SaaS company with the stability of long\-term industry leadership.
* Z\-Factor: We take pride in our culture of passion, care, and high performance. The Z\-Factor defines how we support our teams, foster growth, and ensure that everyone at StarRez thrives.


 If you are excited about building game\-changing products in a high\-impact, collaborative environment—StarRez India is the place for you.
   

  

*We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.*

title: Visual Designer II
description:

 As a Product Visual Designer II, you will collaborate closely with designers, product managers, engineers, and brand teams to shape visually distinctive product experiences for millions of users. You will combine strong visual craft with product thinking to translate complex ideas into interfaces and experiences that are clear, intuitive, and expressive. From high\-fidelity UI and visual systems to illustrations, iconography, prototypes, and key brand moments, your work will elevate the quality and character of the JioHotstar experience across mobile, TV, and web platforms.
 



  





  





**ABOUT THE TEAM:** 





 Design is one of the key teams at JioHotstar. We have 3 key areas of focus \- Product Design, UX Research and Design Standards.
 



 We are a closely\-knit team of 30\+ people at the moment, who work across the spectrum of design from deriving insight from data, designing interfaces and prototypes, and testing with users to motion graphics and illustrations.
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
 


* Craft best\-in\-class visual identities and interfaces that are clean, legible, intuitive, and aesthetically distinctive through typography, composition, colour, iconography, imagery, and illustration.
* Partner with product designers to translate complex concepts, journeys, and interactions into visually compelling, high\-fidelity product experiences.
* Create high\-quality visual design across UI, graphics, illustrations, iconography, prototypes, presentations, videos, and other formats for product experiences, launches, and internal storytelling.
* Shape and extend our visual language, bringing brand expression into the product through scalable visual patterns, components, and guidelines across mobile, web, and TV.
* Collaborate with design, product, research, brand, and engineering from concept to production, ensuring visual intent and craft translate faithfully into the shipped experience.
* Leverage generative and assistive AI tools to accelerate visual exploration, concept development, asset creation, and production without compromising originality or craft.



  





  





**SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES FOR SUCCESS:** 



* Strong visual design fundamentals across typography, composition, layout, colour, hierarchy, iconography, imagery, illustration, and interaction design.
* Exceptional visual taste and attention to detail, with the ability to adapt across different styles and make complex ideas clear, relatable, and visually engaging.
* Strong product sensibility, with an understanding of how visual design can improve usability, hierarchy, comprehension, and the overall product experience.
* Ability to think systematically; creating visual patterns and components that maintain quality and consistency across products, platforms, and screen sizes.
* Versatility across UI, illustration, iconography, graphics, and brand expression, with an interest in extending craft into motion and emerging visual mediums.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate visual decisions and work closely with designers, engineers, and cross\-functional partners.
* Advanced proficiency in Figma and tools such as Illustrator and Photoshop; familiarity with generative AI, prototyping, motion, or 3D tools is a plus.



  





**PREFERRED EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE:** 



* 2–4 years of professional experience in visual, UI, or product design, working on digital products, consumer brands, or within high\-craft creative environments.
* A strong portfolio showcasing high visual craft across UI, illustration, iconography, graphics, or related disciplines, with the ability to adapt across visual styles.
* Demonstrated ability to take complex ideas from early visual exploration to polished, production\-ready execution.
* Experience designing across mobile, web, or TV surfaces is a plus; motion or 3D skills are an added advantage.



  





  





**ABOUT US:** 




 Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media \& entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies.

The company ensures that the work environment is free from any discrimination against persons with disabilities, gender, gender identity and any other characteristics or status that is legally protected.*

title: Brand Designer
description:
Designer
 
**Full\-Time \| 1–3 Years Experience \| Junior to Mid\-Level** 




 NO LINKEDIN APPLICATIONS!!! Apply via email at careers@wishboxstudio.com
 



  




 About the Role
 
 Wishbox Studio is a small, fast\-moving creative agency. We work across social media, branding, web design, packaging, and publications — sometimes all in the same week. If you're looking for a role where every day looks the same, this isn't it.
 



 We're looking for a Designer who is genuinely versatile — someone who can move between a social media grid, a brand identity system, a website layout, and a packaging brief without losing their creative footing. You don't need to be a master of everything yet, but you need to be curious, adaptable, and unafraid of figuring things out.
 



 At Wishbox Studio, designers don't just execute — they contribute. You'll be expected to bring ideas to the table, push back when something doesn't feel right, and care deeply about the quality of what goes out the door. You'll work closely with the brand strategist, creative director, and the founder — and sometimes you'll be the only designer on a project, which means owning it fully.
 



  




 What You'll Do
 * Design across formats — social media creatives, brand identities, website layouts, packaging, presentations, and publications — adapting your approach to each medium.
* Work on multiple projects and clients simultaneously, managing your own time and priorities without constant supervision.
* Collaborate closely with social media strategists, writers, and video editors — contributing to briefs, content calendars, and creative directions, not just receiving them.
* Use AI tools actively in your design process — for ideation, image generation, layout exploration, and workflow efficiency. We expect you to be genuinely fluent here, not just familiar.
* Build and maintain design systems, templates, and brand guidelines that make the team's output faster and more consistent.
* Design for web and digital interfaces using Figma and Framer — from wireframes to polished, production\-ready layouts.
* Bring a sharp eye to every deliverable — typography, hierarchy, colour, spacing. The details matter here.
* Take briefs, interpret them thoughtfully, ask the right questions, and deliver work that goes beyond the obvious.
* Accept feedback gracefully, iterate quickly, and know when to defend a creative decision and when to let it go.
* Stay curious — about design trends, new tools, what's working in the industry, and what the brands you're working on actually need.



  




 What We're Looking For
 * 1–3 years of design experience, ideally with exposure to more than one design category — social media, branding, web, or print.
* Proficiency in Adobe Suite — Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign at minimum.
* Strong working knowledge of Figma.
* Strong working knowledge of Framer.
* Genuine fluency with AI design tools — image generation, prompt\-based design, workflow automation. You use these regularly, not occasionally.
* A solid foundation in design fundamentals — typography, grid systems, colour theory, visual hierarchy. These are non\-negotiable regardless of experience level.
* The ability to work independently and take ownership of a project from brief to final delivery.
* Comfort working in a small team environment where roles overlap and flexibility is essential.
* Strong communication skills — you can explain your design decisions clearly and take direction well.
* An eye for brand consistency — you understand that every touchpoint is part of a larger system, not a standalone piece.
* A portfolio that shows range — we want to see that you can think across categories, not just execute one type of work well.



  




 Nice to Have
 * Experience with motion design or basic animation — After Effects, Rive, or similar.
* Exposure to packaging or print design with an understanding of production requirements.
* Photography or art direction sensibility — you can contribute to shoot briefs and visual direction, not just post\-production.
* Experience working at a creative or digital agency, even in an internship capacity.
* Familiarity with no\-code web tools beyond Framer — Webflow, Squarespace, or similar.



  




 Hiring Process
 
 Shortlisted candidates will be sent a design assignment as the second stage of the hiring process. Please apply only if you're willing to take it on.
 



  




 To Apply
 
 Send us your
 **CV, a portfolio link, and a short note on why this role is the right fit for you right now** 
 at:
 



**careers@wishboxstudio.com**

* Perform materials testing in the lab to evaluate quality, performance, and compliance of metallic and non\-metallic materials

* Collaborate with business users, technical teams, and project stakeholders.
